description: Each station's average bandwidth usage is compared against the mean of the station averages, with every station weighted equally.

b.request: For each observatory station with non-null telescope bandwidth usage, calculate its average usage and compare it with the equally weighted average of those station averages; return the 10 stations with the largest positive margins, showing station, average usage, and margin without rounding
b.sql:
WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes AS t
  WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.observstation
),
with_margin AS (
  SELECT observstation, avg_usage,
         avg_usage - AVG(avg_usage) OVER () AS margin
  FROM station_averages
)
SELECT observstation, avg_usage, margin
FROM with_margin
WHERE margin > 0
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;

a.request: For each observatory station (`observstation`), compute the average bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) of its telescopes, ignoring missing values. Compute the overall average as the mean of these station averages, so each station counts once. Keep only the stations whose average is above this overall average. Show the station, its average bandwidth usage, and how far it is above the overall average (station average minus overall average). Sort by that difference from largest to smallest and return the top 10, without rounding.
a.sql:
WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage
  FROM station_averages
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandwidth_usage,
       s.avg_bandwidth_usage - o.avg_bandwidth_usage AS above_overall_average
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.avg_bandwidth_usage > o.avg_bandwidth_usage
ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

c.request: Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) above the overall average bandwidth usage? Ignore missing values. For each one, show the station, its average bandwidth usage, and how much it exceeds the overall average. Return the top 10 by that margin, largest first, without rounding. Each station's average bandwidth usage is compared against the mean of the station averages, with every station weighted equally.
c.sql:
WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM station_averages
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandusagepct,
       s.avg_bandusagepct - o.avg_bandusagepct AS excess_overall_average
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.avg_bandusagepct > o.avg_bandusagepct
ORDER BY excess_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

d.request: Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) above the mean of all stations’ average bandwidth usage, weighting every station equally? Ignore missing values. For each station, show its average bandwidth usage and how much it exceeds that mean. Return the top 10 by margin, largest first, without rounding.
d.sql:
WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
station_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS mean_station_bandusagepct
  FROM station_averages
)
SELECT sa.observstation,
       sa.avg_bandusagepct,
       sa.avg_bandusagepct - sm.mean_station_bandusagepct AS margin_above_mean
FROM station_averages AS sa
CROSS JOIN station_mean AS sm
WHERE sa.avg_bandusagepct > sm.mean_station_bandusagepct
ORDER BY margin_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
